title: assay.ledger-push/1
description: One line of a push file `pushes/<repo_id>/<pr>.jsonl` in the ledger repository (docs/architecture/06-operations.md §1, 02-architecture.md §5, 03-contracts.md §6c), appended by `open` on each `synchronize`. `seq` is 1 for the first line and one more on each next one (the pending stamp's `seq`); `at` is the push clock; one record per `run_uid`; `run_uid.repo_id` and `pr` are the file's. Unknown fields are rejected.

sender_id.description: Who pushed, by numeric GitHub id; a pusher is never an eligible approver (P10).

time.description: A UTC instant to the millisecond, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ`.
